subject: spanish
title: Stretch: Prepositions and Describing My Town
welcome_lead: Stretch: use prepositions of place and opinions to describe your town in full.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish stretch adventure on prepositions and town descriptions.
final_note: ¡Muy bien! You can describe any town in detailed Spanish.

concepts.def: One can — useful for activities in town.

walkthroughs.body_html: When de meets el, they contract to del. So we say al lado del cine (next to the cinema), NOT 'al lado de el cine'. With la, no contraction: al lado de la iglesia.
Combine prepositions with hay: El supermercado está enfrente del parque y al lado de la panadería. Use entre... y... for 'between... and...': El cine está entre la estación y el café.
Se puede + infinitive = 'one can'. En mi pueblo se puede visitar el museo y comer en restaurantes. Add opinion: Me gusta mi ciudad porque es animada (lively) or aburrida (boring).

mcqs.q: Which is correct: 'next to the cinema'?

numericals.q: If 'entre la estación y la iglesia' is between 2 places, how many places are mentioned?

free_texts.q: Write the Spanish for 'opposite' (preposition, no accents).
